name: Idempotency and Replay Tests
description: Prove that running migration twice produces the same result. Prove that replay from WAL produces the same result.
acceptanceCriteria: Full migration run produces deterministic PGlite state
Second migration run produces bit-identical state (same checksums)
Table row counts are identical across runs
Replaying from checkpoint produces same state as full migration
Automated test passes for idempotency and replay
